introHtml: Galaxy pet treats are made with natural ingredients and come in a variety of flavors that dogs love. When you add your logo through custom imprinting, these treats become a unique giveaway for pet owners attending your next trade show or company picnic. Choose from resealable pouches or single-serve packs to fit your budget and event needs.
